comment.body:
Thanks for describing the multi-monitor blackout and attaching the text log. The attachment shows PowerToys Run/Launcher errors, but it does not identify the window that appeared afterward or connect those errors to the blackout. Please provide:
1. The PowerToys version/release channel active at the time, from Settings > About or the installed app's version.
2. The exact title and visible message of the PowerToys window that appeared; if the text is unclear, upload a screenshot through GitHub with personal content hidden.
If the event happens again, reproduce it and immediately add a comment containing /bugreport so the diagnostic ZIP can be correlated with that occurrence. This will distinguish a PowerToys crash/report prompt from an unrelated display or window-recovery event.
